# 承载规律的投影 / A projection carrying a law

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

> A projection carries a determined law exactly where configurations alike under it go alike; what the step does not depend on is re-absorbed in one step; a system changing its own rule has its law on the joint configuration.
>
> 投影恰在经它相同的配置同去之处承载确定的规律；所不依者一步之内被重新吸收；改变自身规则的系统的规律在联合配置上。

## 主张 Claim

设 P 是配置类型 S、动作类型 A 上的过程，π : S → K 是配置的一个投影（描述）。P 经 π 读的像（Image P π）在 k 与 κ 之间有一步 a，当且仅当 P 的某一步 a 从投影为 k 的配置到投影为 κ 的配置；P 的步骤经 π 分解到它的像（factors_image，FactorsThrough 取自 P53），像是步骤经 π 分解到的最小过程（Image.least）。相同者同去（GoAlike P π）指经 π 相同的两个配置以同一动作到达经 π 相同的配置。不加前提：像确定，恰当相同者同去（image_determined_iff）；某个 K 上的确定过程容许 P 的每一步经 π 读，恰当相同者同去（carries_law_iff）；经恒等，相同者同去就是确定性（goAlike_id_iff）；不分任何东西的描述总相同者同去（goAlike_const）；像的描述 ρ 相同者同去，恰当复合的描述 ρ ∘ π 相同者同去（goAlike_image_iff）。相同者同去时，取相同动作、起点经 π 相同的两个运行在每一步经 π 都相同（GoAlike.runs_agree）。下一配置整个只依于 π（DependsOnlyOn）蕴含相同者同去（DependsOnlyOn.goAlike），且取相同动作、起点经 π 相同的两个运行从第一步起相等（DependsOnlyOn.reabsorbed）；确定的律 next 作为过程只依于 π，恰当经 π 相同的配置下一步相同（Law.dependsOnlyOn_iff），这时轨道从下一步起相同（Law.reabsorbed）；配置读作（状态，规则）、下一配置依于规则而不依于状态时，同一规则的两个配置从下一步起轨道相同（Law.reabsorbed 以规则为投影的情形，即 P62 的 Law.perturbation_reabsorbed，Becoming.Capture 以它证明）。改变自身规则的系统 adaptive F G 中，状态 x 在规则 g 之下以动作 u 变为 F g x u，规则变为 G g x；它是（状态，规则）上的确定过程（adaptive_determined）；状态的投影相同者同去，恰当对每两个规则、每个状态与动作 F 都相同（adaptive_state_law_iff），等价地某个状态上的确定过程容许每一步经状态读（adaptive_state_carries_iff）；沿它的运行，在规则保持为 g 的一段上，状态的各步是规则 g 的确定律 ruleLaw F g 的步（ruleLaw_determined、Run.steps_by_rule）。经投影读：运行在某步之前未于投影为 k 的配置取过 a（Run.TakesThrough），而某个 K 上的确定过程容许运行经 π 读的各步，且 K 有两个不同的元素时，经投影的记录不固定 a 在 k 的任何结果（Run.stepsThrough_retarget、Run.not_fixesThrough_of_untaken）；相同者同去时亦然（Run.not_fixesThrough_of_goAlike）。Coarse 中配置是两个位，每步翻转第一位、第二位任意：过程不确定（Coarse.not_determined），而第一位相同者同去（Coarse.goAlike），步骤经第一位分解到翻转的确定律（Coarse.carries）。Switching 中状态变为规则、规则每步翻转：联合过程确定（Switching.determined），状态的投影不相同者同去（Switching.not_goAlike），从（假，假）出发的运行，对每个 t ≥ 2，没有状态上的确定过程容许它到 t 为止经状态读的各步（Switching.no_state_law）。不用 Lean 公理。 / Let P be a process on configurations S with moves A, and π : S → K a projection (description) of the configuration. P read through π (Image P π) has a step a from k to κ exactly where some step a of P goes from a configuration projecting to k to one projecting to κ; P's step factors through π into its image (factors_image, with FactorsThrough from P53), and the image is the least process the step factors through (Image.least). Configurations alike under π go alike (GoAlike P π) when any two configurations alike under π go by the same move to configurations alike under π. With no premise: the image is determined exactly where configurations alike go alike (image_determined_iff); some determined process on K admits every step of P read through π exactly where configurations alike go alike (carries_law_iff); through the identity, going alike is determinacy (goAlike_id_iff); the description that distinguishes nothing always goes alike (goAlike_const); a description ρ of the image goes alike exactly where the composite ρ ∘ π does (goAlike_image_iff). Where configurations alike go alike, two runs with the same moves from configurations alike under π stay alike under π at every step (GoAlike.runs_agree). The next configuration depending only on π (DependsOnlyOn) implies going alike (DependsOnlyOn.goAlike), and two runs with the same moves from configurations alike under π are equal from the first step on (DependsOnlyOn.reabsorbed); a determined law next depends only on π as a process exactly where configurations alike under π have the same next configuration (Law.dependsOnlyOn_iff), and then their orbits agree from the next step on (Law.reabsorbed); with the configuration read as (state, rule) and the next configuration depending on the rule and not the state, two configurations with the same rule have the same orbit from the next step on (Law.reabsorbed with the rule as the projection, which is P62's Law.perturbation_reabsorbed, proved in Becoming.Capture as this instance). In the system changing its own rule, adaptive F G, the state x under rule g becomes F g x u by move u and the rule becomes G g x; it is a determined process on (state, rule) (adaptive_determined); the state's projection goes alike exactly where F agrees for every two rules at every state and move (adaptive_state_law_iff), equivalently where some determined process on the state admits every step read through the state (adaptive_state_carries_iff); along its runs, on a stretch where the rule stays g, the state's steps are steps of the determined law ruleLaw F g of g (ruleLaw_determined, Run.steps_by_rule). Read through a projection: where the run has not taken a at a configuration projecting to k before some step (Run.TakesThrough), some determined process on K admits the run's steps read through π, and K has two different elements, the record so read fixes no outcome of a at k (Run.stepsThrough_retarget, Run.not_fixesThrough_of_untaken); likewise where configurations alike go alike (Run.not_fixesThrough_of_goAlike). In Coarse the configuration is two bits, each step flips the first and leaves the second free: the process is not determined (Coarse.not_determined), yet the first bit goes alike (Coarse.goAlike) and the step factors through it into the determined law of flipping (Coarse.carries). In Switching the state becomes the rule and the rule flips at every step: the joint process is determined (Switching.determined), the state's projection does not go alike (Switching.not_goAlike), and for the run from (false, false), for every t ≥ 2 no determined process on the state admits the run's steps up to t read through the state (Switching.no_state_law). No Lean axiom is used.

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 不加前提：相同者同去（GoAlike）与只依于（DependsOnlyOn）是被刻画的性质，不是假设；carries_law_iff、image_determined_iff、goAlike_id_iff、goAlike_image_iff、Law.dependsOnlyOn_iff 与 adaptive_state_law_iff 是双向的，对每个过程与每个投影成立。 / No premise: going alike (GoAlike) and depending only on (DependsOnlyOn) are properties characterized, not assumptions; carries_law_iff, image_determined_iff, goAlike_id_iff, goAlike_image_iff, Law.dependsOnlyOn_iff and adaptive_state_law_iff are two-way and hold of every process and every projection.
- 规律指确定的过程（Joint.Determined）；承载指步骤经投影分解到它（FactorsThrough，P53）。 / A law is a determined process (Joint.Determined); carrying means the step factors through the projection into it (FactorsThrough, P53).
- 局部条件写在定理中：runs_agree 与 reabsorbed 要相同的动作与经 π 相同的起点；Run.not_fixesThrough_of_untaken 要某个确定过程容许经 π 读的各步、运行未取、描述中两个不同的元素；Run.steps_by_rule 要规则在该段上保持。 / Local conditions are written into the theorems: runs_agree and reabsorbed need the same moves and starts alike under π; Run.not_fixesThrough_of_untaken needs some determined process admitting the steps read through π, the move untaken, and two different elements of the description; Run.steps_by_rule needs the rule to stay over the stretch.
- 投影 π 与（状态，规则）的分解由运行之外给出；adaptive 中规则的更新 G 不依于动作（取自所贴的 θ′ = G(θ, x)）。 / The projection π and the reading as (state, rule) are supplied from outside the run; in adaptive the rule's update G does not depend on the move (as in the pasted θ′ = G(θ, x)).
- 见证的结论：Coarse 与 Switching 的过程与运行。 / For the witnesses: the processes and runs of Coarse and Switching.
- 离散的步（从第 0 步计）；配置、动作与描述是任意类型。 / Discrete steps, counted from step 0; configurations, moves and descriptions of any type.

Ren 2026-10-12 问：“hows cause–effect system comparing to our theory?”，贴入一段作者未注明的说明（不是 Ren 的话，不是前提），又写“think for one more round, what can we learn, being inspired, and improve?”；对 AI 的五项提议答：“Great, let's finish all of them, you can spawn sub agents in a wise order if needed”。这是第三项（机制是一种分解，不是另一种规律），工作板 P66。读法（AI 的，待 Ren）：机制是承载规律的投影，P53 的“关于何者无关的模型”由相同者同去精确刻画；配置的投影是时间读法与更细的量的单位之外的第三种东西；较粗描述上的规律（涌现）就是那里的相同者同去，不分任何东西的描述总承载规律，所以内容在于哪个描述；规则持有结果（P62 B5）是只依于规则；改变自身因果的系统的规律在状态与规则的联合配置上，不需要另一种规律；合于 §72 的读法，理 是投影，它何时承载规律由此给出。见整合文档 §88。 / On 12 October 2026 Ren asked “hows cause–effect system comparing to our theory?”, pasted an explanation whose author is not stated (not Ren's wording, not a premise), asked “think for one more round, what can we learn, being inspired, and improve?”, and to the AI's five proposals answered “Great, let's finish all of them, you can spawn sub agents in a wise order if needed”. This is the third proposal (a mechanism is a factoring, not a further kind of law), work-board item P66. Readings (the AI's, pending Ren): a mechanism is a projection that carries a law, and P53's model of what is irrelevant is characterized exactly by going alike; a projection of configuration is a third thing beside readings of time and finer units of amount; a law at a coarser description (emergence) is going alike there, and since the description that distinguishes nothing always carries one, the content lies in which description carries it; the rule holding the outcome (P62's B5) is dependence on the rule only; a system that changes its own causality has its law on the joint configuration of state and rule, and needs no further kind of law; on §72's reading of 理 as a projection, this says when 理 carries a law. See §88 of the integration note.

实际展开经哪个投影承载规律、任何形成形成或使用一个投影、规则怎样开始改变，都不推出；规律只指确定的过程，有结构而不确定的规律与概率没有陈述；与 GenerativeCore 中有限路径精确投影（projection_exact_iff）的关系没有陈述；状态规律的判据 adaptive_state_law_iff 是对一切配置的，沿一个运行的充要条件没有陈述；规则更新依于动作的系统没有陈述；见证是最小的；主定理近于定义，增量在于刻画与最小候选；“机制”的读法只取科学哲学中机制概念“在一个描述上有规律”这一面；读法是 AI 的，待 Ren；不含伦理谓词。 / Which projection an actual unfolding carries a law through, that any formation forms or uses a projection, and how a rule comes to change are not derived; a law means a determined process, and structured undetermined laws and probabilities are not treated; the relation to GenerativeCore's exact projection of finite paths (projection_exact_iff) is not stated; the state-law criterion adaptive_state_law_iff ranges over all configurations, and the iff along one run is not stated; systems whose rule update depends on the move are not stated; the witnesses are minimal; the main theorems are near-definitional, the delta being the characterization and the least candidate; the reading of mechanism takes only the aspect “a law at a description” of the philosophy-of-science notion; the readings are the AI's, pending Ren; contains no ethical predicate.

## 复用与下一增量 Reuse and next delta

沿一个运行的充要条件：到某步为止有确定过程容许经 π 读的各步，恰当经 π 相同、动作相同的两步到达经 π 相同的配置（构造性）；以 Becoming.Testing 的识为投影的实例（任一投影上经它的实验何时正确已由 P73 的 transfer_right_iff 给出）；与 GenerativeCore 精确投影的桥接；规则缓慢改变时状态在长段上的规律。 / The iff along one run: some determined process admits the steps read through π up to a step exactly where two steps alike under π with the same move reach configurations alike under π (constructive); the instance with Becoming.Testing's registration as the projection (when an experiment through any projection is right is now given by P73's transfer_right_iff); the bridge to GenerativeCore's exact projection; the state's law over long stretches where the rule changes slowly.
